motion.method: Pre-motion frames: evidence/pre-motion-hashes.json (SHA-256 of the v3 frames before motion). The capture is byte-deterministic, so equal hashes mean identical pixels.

daily-ar-1440x900-tuner-open.expectedToChange: the tuner panel gained its Motion group

spec.motion: Load: stat cards enter
spec.animates: opacity 0 to 1, transform translateY(14px) to none

spec.motion: Load: chart card enters
spec.animates: opacity 0 to 1, transform translateY(18px) to none

spec.motion: Load: the line draws from opening to now
spec.animates: SVG stroke-dasharray (drawn length) of today's line; fine vertical lines opacity behind the head (36px soft edge)

spec.motion: Load: end point appears (when the line reaches now)
spec.animates: opacity 0 to 1, scale 0.4 to 1

spec.motion: Load: peak marker appears (after the line)
spec.animates: opacity 0 to 1; ring scale 0.5 to 1; label translate 0 5px to 0

spec.motion: Load: Inside now light slides in behind the fixed disc, out of the lit corner
spec.animates: transform translate(-105.2px, 91.3px) to translate(0px, 0px) on the light layer and its grain (.lamp-in ::before and ::after, overscan --lp 148px); the disc (the mask on .lamp-in) stays; no opacity change
spec.note: lights entrance: the tuner's "switch on at load", on by default; the light starts 50% of the corner-to-disc-centre distance beyond the lit corner, on that axis (computed from the light settings)

spec.motion: Load: Inside now lit border catches the light
spec.animates: opacity along the movement's own progress (same timing and easing): 0%: 0, 35%: 0.45, 70%: 0.9, 100%: 1 of the rest value, on .lamp-rim

spec.motion: Load: chart light rises from under the bottom edge with the line
spec.animates: transform translate(0px, 297px) to translate(0px, 0px) on the light layer and its grain (50% of the card height); the disc stays
spec.note: starts with the line (same delay) and settles just after it reaches now

spec.motion: Load: chart light brightens as it rises
spec.animates: opacity along the movement's own progress (same timing and easing): 0%: 0, 25%: 0.8, 100%: 1 of the rest value, on .lamp-in

spec.motion: Load: chart lit border catches the light
spec.animates: opacity along the movement's own progress (same timing and easing): 0%: 0, 35%: 0.45, 70%: 0.9, 100%: 1 of the rest value, on .lamp-rim

spec.motion: Load: page wash drifts in from its corner
spec.animates: transform translate(120px, -60px) to translate(0px, 0px) on .wash-light; opacity along the movement's own progress (same timing and easing): 0%: 0, 30%: 0.5, 60%: 0.85, 100%: 1 of the rest value, on .wash

spec.motion: Load: the rail's rim catches the wash
spec.animates: opacity along the movement's own progress (same timing and easing): 0%: 0, 35%: 0.45, 70%: 0.9, 100%: 1 of the rest value, on .rail::after

spec.motion: Live: end-point pulse (live state only; none while delayed)
spec.animates: a ring: opacity 0.7 to 0, transform scale 0.28 to 1 (9px to 32px)
spec.note: infinite, the ring is visible for the first 62% of each 3.6s cycle; HTML layer, composited

spec.motion: Live: new reading, tail morph and extension
spec.animates: SVG path d of the last ~15-30 minutes only (from the last line point before the first changed minute), end point cx/cy, the tail's fine lines, the now clip

spec.motion: Numbers: cross-fade
spec.animates: new value opacity 0 to 1; old value (a copy) opacity 1 to 0

spec.motion: Tooltip and guide follow (pointer and keyboard)
spec.animates: transform translate from the previous position to none
spec.note: 140ms plus 0.12ms per px moved, at most 320ms; the tooltip fades in 120ms and out 90ms

spec.motion: Rail opens
spec.animates: end cap transform translateX(0 to 156px, inline-end), middle transform scaleX(0 to 1) from the inline-start, surface opacity 0.7 to 0.94 (a layer's opacity), shadow layer opacity 0 to 1; names opacity + translateX(6px) with 80ms delay, 240ms
spec.note: width switches at once and is never animated

spec.motion: Rail closes
spec.animates: the same in reverse; names opacity 1 to 0 in 110ms

spec.motion: Lights follow the pointer (desktop, fine pointer only; Inside now; chart card off by default)
spec.animates: transform translate on the light and grain layers (overscan --lp 24px), at most 10px x 7px (chart 6px x 4px); nothing is promoted to its own layer at rest, so a pointer at the card centre (offset 0) leaves the light where it is
spec.note: CSS transition, restarted per frame while the pointer moves; returns to rest in 900ms on leave

spec.motion: Light follows crowd (toggle, off by default)
spec.animates: opacity of the Inside now light: Quiet 0.42, Moderate 0.7, Busy 1, Packed 1

ar.tolerance: +0.01 in cube-root luminance (about OKLab L), 7x7 blur

en.tolerance: +0.01 in cube-root luminance (about OKLab L), 7x7 blur

counterfactualTowardDiscCentreAr.note: The Inside now light started 34% of the way from the lit corner toward the disc's centre (nowFrom -0.34) and slid out from there, everything else as built; then the same with its opacity rising along the way. Only the Inside now results apply.

points.label: pointer near the far top corner (top right in Arabic)
pointer by the lit corner (bottom left in Arabic)

lightMeasurement.method: OKLab L relative to the card's own base on light-only 1x captures (content hidden); see capture.mjs measure()

targets.chart: pure dark >= ~75%, dim haze <= 15%, light fades to black within ~15-35% of the card height (NEXT-DIRECTION-BRIEF Round 5 section 2)
targets.insideNowReference: reference light 4 at y=0.98: far corner 0.45, middle 0.19-0.30, lit corner 0.74-0.79; at y=0.95 the middle 0.15 (coordinator's measurement)
